instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Keep all existing test IDs in PublicCatalog.js intact (e.g. public-catalog, header-logo, hero-cta-planes, public-tab-*, public-product-*, etc.).
2. Add the OpenFactura highlighted section into PublicCatalog.js after the App Mobile section or before the Marquee section, with clean Bento cards showcasing all 8 key features.
3. Add 'OpenFactura' link in the main navigation header in PublicCatalog.js linking to '/openfactura'.
4. Create the dedicated OpenFactura page at /app/frontend/src/pages/public/OpenFacturaPage.js and register the route /openfactura in App.js.
5. Ensure all CTA buttons for 'Prueba gratis 14 días' point to https://openfactura.es/registro.
6. Maintain brand design consistency: Outfit headings, Manrope body, #015EEF primary blue, #FF7A00 accent orange, and #05070D dark sections.
